prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 26 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1215; do not mention it.)
text:
Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes. The patient reported immediate pain and restricted range of motion in the right shoulder. Initial evaluation documented tenderness over the anterior shoulder, reduced active abduction and forward flexion, and pain with overhead reaching. Imaging was reviewed and showed no fracture; findings were consistent with a rotator cuff strain with associated soft tissue inflammation.

Over the course of care, the patient completed 26 visits consisting of supervised physical therapy, manual therapy to the glenohumeral joint, progressive strengthening of the rotator cuff and scapular stabilizers, and a home exercise program. Anti-inflammatory medication was used early in treatment and was tapered as symptoms improved. Range of motion and strength improved steadily across the course of care, and pain with daily activities decreased substantially.

At discharge, the patient demonstrated near-full active range of motion, improved grip and rotator cuff strength, and was able to return to most work and household activities. Residual mild discomfort with heavy overhead lifting remains. The patient was instructed to continue the home exercise program and to return if symptoms worsen.
